name: Form Builder CP
author: codepeople

sections.description:
With Form Builder CP, you can:

  • Design custom forms visually with an intuitive drag-and-drop form builder
  • Receive form submissions directly via email
  • Enforce inline field validation rules
  • Protect forms with built-in CAPTCHA anti-spam verification
  • Customize form layouts, labels, and CSS styles
  • Personalize email notification templates and thank-you redirect pages

Form Builder CP is a WordPress plugin that lets you create contact forms, booking forms, and other data-capture forms and send submissions directly via email.

The visual form builder includes real-time field validation and anti-spam CAPTCHA image verification out of the box. Building a form is as simple as clicking or dragging fields into the form canvas and arranging them in your preferred order.

This free version supports three core form field types: Single Line Text, Email, and Text Area. Each field type can be added an unlimited number of times within the same form, covering the vast majority of standard contact and inquiry forms. Commercial versions of the plugin are also available with additional field types and advanced features—learn more at https://wordpress.dwbooster.com/forms/cp-easy-form-builder.

Form Builder CP Features

  • Create contact forms visually using a clean, modern drag-and-drop interface
  • Send form submissions to one or more email addresses
  • Optionally include sender metadata (IP address, referer URL, server timestamp, and user agent)
  • Customize email message templates and post-submission redirect URLs
  • Built-in inline validation for required fields, email addresses, character limits, and more
  • Includes built-in CAPTCHA image verification with a refresh button—no external anti-spam services or API keys required
  • AJAX-based CAPTCHA verification for a fast, seamless user experience without unnecessary page reloads
  • Responsive, mobile-friendly form rendering and validation

The core of Form Builder CP is its interactive JavaScript form builder. While the free edition provides Single Line Text, Email, and Text Area fields, Pro editions unlock additional field types and conditional logic. You can also assign custom CSS classes to individual fields (see the FAQ) to arrange multiple fields side by side in columns.

The integrated validation engine checks required inputs, email address formatting, confirmation fields, and minimum or maximum character lengths before submission.

The CAPTCHA system is completely self-contained within the plugin—no third-party CAPTCHA accounts are needed. You can customize its dimensions, font, background tint, border color, and noise level directly in the CAPTCHA Verification settings panel, and verify codes via AJAX without reloading the page.

Updates

Form Builder CP continues to evolve based on community feedback and feature requests, with tens of thousands of installations worldwide. Thank you to everyone who has supported the plugin, shared suggestions, and helped improve each release!
If the form doesn’t appear: If the form fails to render on your public website, this is usually caused by a JavaScript conflict with your theme or a script-optimization plugin. You can resolve this in two ways:

  1. Go to CP Easy Form Builder > Troubleshoot Area in the WordPress admin dashboard and switch the Script load method between Classic and Direct.

  2. Alternatively, edit cp_easy_form_builder.php and set CP_EASYFORM_DEFAULT_DEFER_SCRIPTS_LOADING to true:

    define(‘CP_EASYFORM_DEFAULT_DEFER_SCRIPTS_LOADING’, true);

This changes how scripts are loaded to prevent conflicts with themes or optimization plugins that override jQuery.

Other Form Builder CP editions: Commercial Pro editions of Form Builder CP add support for:

  • Additional form field types: file uploads, phone numbers, passwords, numbers, dates, checkboxes, radio buttons, and drop-down selects
  • Extra layout elements: section breaks, page breaks (multi-page forms), and instructional text blocks
  • Conditional field dependencies (show/hide fields dynamically based on user selections)
  • Multiple independent forms on the same website
  • Automatic file upload handling and email attachments
  • Dynamic field tags in email notifications
  • Automatic confirmation email copies (auto-reply) to the user
  • Full WordPress Multisite compatibility

Learn more at https://wordpress.dwbooster.com/forms/cp-easy-form-builder.
sections.installation:
To install Form Builder CP, follow these steps:

  1. Download and unzip the Form Builder CP plugin archive.
  2. Upload the entire cp-easy-form-builder/ directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate Form Builder CP through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Configure your forms and email settings in the WordPress admin dashboard under CP Easy Form Builder (or Settings > CP Easy Form Builder).
  5. Insert your form into any post or page using the CP Easy Form Builder Gutenberg block, the Classic Editor toolbar icon, or the [CP_EASY_FORM_WILL_APPEAR_HERE] shortcode.
sections.faq:
What does each field in the settings area mean?

The Form Builder CP documentation page provides detailed explanations for every setting and customization option:

https://wordpress.dwbooster.com/forms/cp-easy-form-builder

How can I apply custom CSS styles to form fields?

In the visual form builder, click any field to open its Field Settings tab and enter your custom class name in the Additional CSS Class field (labeled Add CSS Layout Keywords in earlier versions).

Note: Enter only the CSS class name(s) in that setting, not raw CSS rules.

Define your CSS rules either in your theme’s stylesheet (or Appearance > Customize > Additional CSS) or inside css/stylepublic.css in the cp-easy-form-builder plugin directory.

Can I align form fields into two or more columns?

Yes. Click a field in the form builder to open its Field Settings tab and enter one of the built-in column classes in the Additional CSS Class input:

column2
column3
column4

For example, to place two fields side by side on the same row, assign the class column2 to both fields.

What is the Form Builder CP shortcode for publishing a form?

Use the following shortcode to embed your form:

[CP_EASY_FORM_WILL_APPEAR_HERE id="1"]

You can paste this shortcode into any post, page, or widget, or render it in a theme template using WordPress’s do_shortcode() function. When editing in the Block Editor (Gutenberg), you can also insert the CP Easy Form Builder block directly, or use the insert icon in the Classic Editor toolbar.

How can I modify the submit button design?

You can target the .pbSubmit class (for example, .cpp_form .pbSubmit) in your theme’s CSS or in cp-easy-form-builder/css/stylepublic.css to customize colors, padding, borders, and hover states.

For structural HTML adjustments, the submit button markup is located in cp_easyform_public_int.inc.php.

How can I edit the submit button label?

Open your form’s settings page and go to the Buttons & Validation Messages section, where you can customize the Submit, Previous, and Next button labels.

Can I display hints or instructions for users on each field?

Yes. Click any field in the form builder and locate the Instructions for User box in the Field Settings tab.

Enter your helper text there. If you check Show as floating tooltip, the instructions appear in a tooltip when the user hovers over or focuses on the field. If left unchecked, the instructions remain visible directly beneath the field.
